title: Hand Shattered Shio Koji Australian Fennel Sausage Tagine
description: A citrus-forward Australian fusion dish where shio-koji cured halal sausages are roughly broken by hand and slow-cooked in a traditional clay vessel.
instructions: Toss the sausages in liquid shio koji and refrigerate for thirty minutes to cure the meat.
Remove the sausages from the marinade and shatter them into irregular chunks using your hands.
Heat the olive oil in the base of the clay tagine over medium heat.
Saute the sliced onions until they become translucent and slightly caramelized.
Add the shattered sausage pieces to the tagine and brown them for five minutes.
Stir in the chopped preserved lemon and the drained chickpeas.
Pour the blood orange juice over the mixture to provide a bright citrus base.
Place the conical lid on the tagine and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer the mixture for twenty-five minutes until the sauce has thickened and the flavors merge.
Remove from heat and garnish generously with fresh cilantro before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
